locale.zh-CN: 语言包。不传、传 undefined 或 null 时继承外层 LocaleProvider 的语言，最外层都没有时组件回退 zh_CN；ConfigProvider 的 locale 优先于它。
locale.en-US: Locale pack. When omitted, undefined or null, the language of the outer LocaleProvider is inherited; without any outer provider, components fall back to zh_CN. The locale of ConfigProvider takes precedence over it.

children.en-US: Subtree that uses the locale pack.

componentName.zh-CN: 要读取的语言包命名空间，如 TimePicker；只接受 Locale 中声明的组件名，自定义命名空间通过 declaration merging 扩展 Locale。
componentName.en-US: Namespace of the locale pack to read, such as TimePicker. Only component names declared in Locale are accepted; extend Locale by declaration merging for custom namespaces.

children.zh-CN: 函数子节点，参数依次为 componentName 对应的文案片段 locale、localeCode、dateFnsLocale 与 currency。
children.en-US: Function child receiving the text of componentName (locale), localeCode, dateFnsLocale and currency, in that order.
